Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Blinkit's product page cart flow - "Add to cart" morphs into a quantity stepper, and a sticky "View cart" bar assembles at the bottom with stacked product thumbnails that grow as items are added and shrink as they are removed.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Product detail page (hero image, variant thumbnails, info accordions, price row). Bottom CTA area: green "Add to cart" button; once items exist, a green "View cart" pill bar with overlapping circular product thumbnails on its left, item count, and chevron.

## Motion spec
Pattern: button-to-stepper morph + accumulating cart bar.
- Tap "Add to cart": the button morphs in place into a stepper (- 1 +) - width holds, label crossfades to controls (~200ms, ease-out).
- The product thumbnail flies from the product area into the View-cart bar's thumbnail stack (~300ms arc, ease-in-out), stack count bumps with a small scale pop (1 -> 1.15 -> 1, spring ~400/20).
- Bar entrance (first add): slides up from bottom edge (spring ~320/28).
- Stepper taps: count swaps instantly, thumbnail stack adds/removes the rightmost circle with a 150ms slide; reaching 0 reverses everything - stepper morphs back to "Add to cart", bar slides away.

## Calibration
- The flying thumbnail is the delight: one clean arc, no spin.
- Stepper and bar are independent - stepper can hit 0 while other items keep the bar alive.

## Reduced motion
No flying thumbnail; counts and stack crossfade (150ms).

## Don't miss
- Thumbnails overlap as a stack (most recent on top), max ~3 visible.
- The morph is in-place: the button never jumps position when becoming a stepper.
